about: What every HTTP client must do beyond building requests and decoding answers. A client test names the obligation it proves in a comment, `spec/client.json: <name>`, and scripts/client_obligations.py fails CI when a client lacks one.

obligations.sends_the_key: The key travels in the X-API-Key header.
obligations.refuses_redirects: A redirect is not followed, as it would carry the key to another host.
obligations.times_out_a_stalled_body: One deadline covers the whole exchange, so a body that stalls or drips ends as a transport failure.
obligations.failures_are_values: A refused request, an unreachable host and a timeout come back as values that never contain the key.
obligations.caps_the_body: A body over 1 MB ends as a transport failure, and the rest of it is not read.
obligations.ignores_a_trailing_slash: A base URL ending in a slash sends the same paths as one without.
obligations.refuses_an_unusable_key: Whitespace around the key is dropped. A key no header can hold is refused before anything is sent, as a value that never contains it.
